products.name: HireVue
products.note: Video interviewing AI; facial analysis controversy; algorithmic hiring bias; regulatory scrutiny

profile_text.body:
HireVue is a for-profit company founded in 2004 and headquartered in South Jordan, Utah. The company describes itself as a provider of AI-powered video interviewing, skills assessments, and candidate evaluation tools aimed at helping employers validate candidate skills and competencies. Its site highlights use cases such as recruiting early-career talent through automated video interviews and AI-driven assessments, positioning the platform as a way to identify candidates without requiring on-campus visits.

HireVue's core product is its AI-driven hiring platform, tracked under the HR and Talent AI category, which has drawn attention for its use of facial analysis, concerns around algorithmic hiring bias, and regulatory scrutiny. The company faces at least one active legal matter, Rodrigues v. HireVue, Inc., filed in the District Court for the Western District of Missouri. The held facts also associate HireVue with 39 entries of legal exposure connected to Utah, consistent with its headquarters location in that state.
